complexity.notes: Swapping the manual while-loop counter for a reversed range is cleaner and less error-prone. The recurrence is correct and the constant-space rolling state is already the optimal shape for this problem; no asymptotic improvement is possible since every cost must be read at least once.
complexity.summary: Bottom-up DP walking from the end of the array, keeping only the minimum costs to reach the top from the next two indices in two rolling variables; the answer is the cheaper of starting at index 0 or 1.
